note: vespera_inprocess: a fully materialised DIRECT overflow (a large hoisted 422, a synthesized error wire) now streams its body through the body callback instead of inside the header callback, so a stashed overflow streamed by the bridge no longer answers an empty body. vespera: cron schedulers no longer probe the caller's Tokio runtime for a time driver by catching a panic (noisy stderr, and an abort under panic = "abort"); they sleep on a vespera-owned timer thread and run on the current runtime whether or not it enables timers. Test and bench integrity fixes: the dispatch_path bench clones outside the timed region, the shutdown drain test proves it waited for the lease, header-first disconnect tests stop on a failed data write, allocation budgets check the measured status, and the multipart strict / validation envelope checks pin the shipped behaviour.
